review.reviewer: current Codex assistant, candidate author and explicit source/algorithm reviewer
review.algorithm_assessment: Sweep chairs left-to-right while tracking the number of directed path components. Endpoint charges include signed coordinates so every eventual edge receives its absolute distance plus takeoff/landing costs. Ordinary vertices open, extend, or merge components; start/end have only one incident path edge. Availability checks account for components lacking an incoming/outgoing endpoint. Prohibit joining the start-to-end component before the final chair, preventing disconnected premature completion and cycles.
review.limitations: One source reviewer plus actual isolated tests, not independent dual semantic review.
